title: The #1 reason people quit
caption: We asked listeners why they quit their side hustle. The top answer wasn't money.
why: Opens on a question viewers instinctively answer (and get wrong), then pays off with a quotable line.

title: Welcome to the valley of nothing
caption: Week six. Zero sales, eleven views, and your mom liked the post. Here's why that's good news.
why: Hyper-relatable pain point, a named concept, a laugh line, and an optimistic twist at the end.

title: Two rules that beat motivation
caption: Twenty minutes a day beats a perfect weekend once a month. Track the reps, not the results.
why: Concrete, saveable advice with two quotable one-liners; high save/share potential.

title: Decision fatigue kills side hustles
caption: Pick an end date in advance so you stop re-deciding every morning.
why: Counterintuitive tactic plus a mug-worthy line and a light comedic button.

title: If you quit before, watch this
caption: Quitting before isn't proof you can't do this. Shrink the plan, not the dream.
why: Emotional, encouraging, very shareable; short enough to loop.
